<style>
.sid2{--navy:#10233f;--cyan:#0e9bb5;--cyan-dark:#087f95;--ink:#172235;--muted:#5b6574;--line:#d7e0e7;--paper:#fff;--wash:#f4f7f9;color:var(--ink);font-family:"Noto Sans JP",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}
.sid2 *{box-sizing:border-box}
.sid2 a{color:var(--cyan-dark);text-underline-offset:.18em}
.sid2 a:focus-visible,.sid2 button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f2bd2f;outline-offset:3px}
.sid2-tab-scroll{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:.35rem;overflow-x:auto;margin:0 0 .8rem;padding:.15rem 0 .55rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);scrollbar-width:thin;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.sid2-tabs{display:flex;gap:.35rem;flex:0 0 auto}
.sid2-tab,.sid2-work{min-height:44px;padding:.62rem .78rem;border:1px solid #c6d1da;border-radius:.35rem;background:#fff;color:var(--navy);font:700 .84rem/1.3 inherit;white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}
.sid2-tab[aria-selected="true"]{border-color:var(--navy);background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.sid2-work{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border-color:#9bd0da;background:#edf8fa;color:#075f70}
.sid2-panel{scroll-margin-top:1rem}
.sid2.is-enhanced .sid2-panel[hidden]{display:none}
.sid2-panel-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:.7rem;margin:.2rem 0 .55rem}
.sid2-panel-head h2{margin:0;color:var(--navy);font-size:1.08rem;line-height:1.45}
.sid2-panel-head span{color:var(--muted);font-size:.72rem}
.sid2-lead{display:grid;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:5px solid var(--cyan);background:#fff}
.sid2-lead-media{position:relative;min-height:170px;background:#e9f4f6}
.sid2-lead-media img,.sid2-lead-media svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;min-height:170px;max-height:235px;object-fit:cover}
.sid2-lead-copy{padding:1rem}
.sid2-badge{display:inline-block;margin:0 0 .38rem;padding:.16rem .45rem;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.04em}
.sid2-lead h3{margin:.12rem 0 .42rem;color:var(--navy);font-size:clamp(1.12rem,4.8vw,1.48rem);line-height:1.5}
.sid2-lead p{margin:.42rem 0;font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.75}
.sid2-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.22rem .62rem;margin:.45rem 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.72rem;line-height:1.55}
.sid2-primary{display:inline-block;margin-top:.35rem;font-size:.84rem;font-weight:800}
.sid2-list{margin:.65rem 0 0;border-top:3px solid var(--navy);background:#fff}
.sid2-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:.25rem .75rem;padding:.72rem .25rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.sid2-item h3{grid-column:1;margin:0;color:var(--navy);font-size:.91rem;line-height:1.55}
.sid2-item .sid2-kind{grid-column:2;grid-row:1;align-self:start;padding:.12rem .36rem;border:1px solid #b6c6d2;border-radius:999px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.64rem;white-space:nowrap}
.sid2-item p{grid-column:1/-1;margin:.08rem 0;font-size:.79rem;line-height:1.6}
.sid2-item .sid2-source{grid-column:1/-1;color:var(--muted);font-size:.7rem;line-height:1.55}
.sid2-disclaimer{margin:.75rem 0 0;padding:.7rem .8rem;border:1px solid #cad4dd;background:var(--wash);font-size:.76rem;line-height:1.7}
.sid2-noscript{margin:.6rem 0;padding:.65rem .75rem;border:1px solid #d1a94d;background:#fff9e8;font-size:.78rem}
@media (min-width:820px){
  .sid2-lead{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,44%) minmax(0,56%)}
  .sid2-lead-media img,.sid2-lead-media svg{max-height:none;height:100%}
  .sid2-lead-copy{padding:1.25rem}
  .sid2-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0 1rem}
  .sid2-item:nth-child(odd){border-right:1px solid var(--line);padding-right:1rem}
  .sid2-item:nth-child(even){padding-left:0}
}
@media (max-width:520px){
  .sid2-tab-scroll{margin-bottom:.55rem}
  .sid2-tab,.sid2-work{padding:.58rem .7rem}
  .sid2-panel-head{margin-top:.05rem}
  .sid2-lead-media{min-height:150px}
  .sid2-lead-media img,.sid2-lead-media svg{min-height:150px;max-height:190px}
  .sid2-lead-copy{padding:.85rem}
}
</style>

<script>
(function(){
  var root=document.querySelector('.sid2');
  if(!root){return;}
  var tabs=Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"][data-panel]'));
  var panels=Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('[role="tabpanel"][data-panel-id]'));
  var ids=tabs.map(function(tab){return tab.getAttribute('data-panel');});
  root.classList.add('is-enhanced');

  function activate(id,updateHash,moveFocus){
    if(ids.indexOf(id)===-1){id='major';}
    tabs.forEach(function(tab){
      var on=tab.getAttribute('data-panel')===id;
      tab.setAttribute('aria-selected',on?'true':'false');
      tab.setAttribute('tabindex',on?'0':'-1');
      if(on&&moveFocus){tab.focus();}
    });
    panels.forEach(function(panel){panel.hidden=panel.getAttribute('data-panel-id')!==id;});
    if(updateHash){
      var next=id==='major'?'#major':'#'+id;
      if(window.location.hash!==next){window.history.pushState(null,'',next);}
    }
  }

  tabs.forEach(function(tab,index){
    tab.addEventListener('click',function(){activate(tab.getAttribute('data-panel'),true,false);});
    tab.addEventListener('keydown',function(event){
      var next=index;
      if(event.key==='ArrowRight'){next=(index+1)%tabs.length;}
      else if(event.key==='ArrowLeft'){next=(index-1+tabs.length)%tabs.length;}
      else if(event.key==='Home'){next=0;}
      else if(event.key==='End'){next=tabs.length-1;}
      else{return;}
      event.preventDefault();
      activate(tabs[next].getAttribute('data-panel'),true,true);
    });
  });

  window.addEventListener('hashchange',function(){activate(window.location.hash.slice(1),false,false);});
  activate(window.location.hash.slice(1)||root.getAttribute('data-default-panel')||'major',false,false);
})();
</script>
